items.hed: The Houston Texans are coming off Thursday's 26-3 blowout of the Indianapolis Colts at Reliant Stadium and remain on an extended break before their Week 12 home matchup against the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29
items.insight: C.J. Stroud threw for three touchdowns in the Thursday night win, and the Texans held Indianapolis without a touchdown for the first time since 2024, according to the team's own schedule page. With no game this week, Houston's coaching staff continues extra preparation before hosting Baltimore in Week 12, with full broadcast and streaming information carried on the team's official site.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium (formerly Reliant Stadium), Houston. Venue still.

items.hed: New Astros manager Brad Ausmus is rounding his coaching staff into shape, hiring former Dodgers hitting coach Aaron Bates for the same role and Atlanta bullpen coach J.P. Martinez as the club's new pitching coach
items.insight: MLB.com reports Bates spent 12 years in the Dodgers' organization, including the last four seasons as co-hitting coach with Robert Van Scoyoc, a stretch in which Los Angeles ranked top-four in the majors in runs scored every year. The twin hires mark the first major staff moves of the Ausmus era in Houston as the club continues reshaping its coaching room this offseason.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Houston Rockets beat the Los Angeles Clippers 116-104 at Toyota Center on Monday night behind Kevin Durant's 32 points, bouncing back from Friday's loss at Denver
items.insight: The win came in the Rockets' first home game since Friday's 133-124 loss to the Nuggets, giving Houston a positive result to close the week at Toyota Center, according to the league's own box-score pages. The team's next scheduled matchup and broadcast information is carried on the Rockets' official schedule page.
